groups.name: stx.telemetry
groups.description: Logs and traces for this application, through stx-telemetry.

groups.name: stx.telemetry.otlp
groups.description: The OTLP/HTTP exporter, when stx-telemetry-otlp is on the classpath.

properties.name: stx.telemetry.enabled
properties.description: Build and install an stx-telemetry root for this application, and make each request a server span. Off by default.

properties.name: stx.telemetry.service
properties.description: The service.name every signal reports. Falls back to spring.application.name, and to unknown-service when there is neither — a fleet of processes with the same name is a fleet with no telemetry, so this is worth setting.

properties.name: stx.telemetry.version
properties.description: The service.version every signal reports.

properties.name: stx.telemetry.environment
properties.description: The deployment.environment.name every signal reports: production, staging.

properties.name: stx.telemetry.minimum
properties.description: The lowest severity emitted at all: debug, info, warn or error. Spans are governed by sample-ratio, not by this.

properties.name: stx.telemetry.sample-ratio
properties.description: The share of traces kept, from 0.0 to 1.0. Decided once at a trace's root and carried in the traceparent, and by trace id rather than a coin toss, so two services at the same ratio keep the same traces. Logs are never sampled.

properties.name: stx.telemetry.stack-traces
properties.description: Whether a failure's stack trace is rendered into the signal. Off for a deployment whose bill is per byte.

properties.name: stx.telemetry.batch
properties.description: How many signals ship to an exporter together at most.

properties.name: stx.telemetry.linger
properties.description: How long a partial batch waits for company before shipping anyway.

properties.name: stx.telemetry.drain-timeout
properties.description: How long shutdown waits for the queue to drain before giving up on it, so a collector that stopped answering does not stop the process exiting.

properties.name: stx.telemetry.console
properties.description: Adds a ConsoleExporter: one human-readable line per signal on stdout. For development.

properties.name: stx.telemetry.json-lines
properties.description: Adds a JsonLinesExporter: one JSON object per line on stdout, for a collector that reads the container's log.

properties.name: stx.telemetry.web-filter
properties.description: Whether each request becomes a server span, continuing an incoming traceparent and renamed to the matched route once WebFlux knows it.

properties.name: stx.telemetry.ignore
properties.description: Path prefixes that get no span. A health check answered every second by a load balancer is a trace nobody will read and most of the traces there are.

properties.name: stx.telemetry.otlp.enabled
properties.description: Export to an OTLP collector over HTTP in JSON. Needs stx-telemetry-otlp on the classpath.

properties.name: stx.telemetry.otlp.endpoint
properties.description: The collector's base URL; /v1/logs and /v1/traces are appended.

properties.name: stx.telemetry.otlp.headers
properties.description: Headers sent on every request — an API key, a tenant header.

properties.name: stx.telemetry.otlp.timeout
properties.description: Connect and request timeout.

properties.name: stx.telemetry.otlp.attempts
properties.description: How many times one document is sent before giving up. 1 disables retrying. A 408, 429 or 5xx and a connection failure are retried; any other 4xx is not, because the same document would be wrong again.

properties.name: stx.telemetry.otlp.backoff
properties.description: The first wait between attempts; it doubles each time.

properties.name: stx.telemetry.otlp.gzip
properties.description: Compresses the body. Every OTLP/HTTP receiver is required to understand it.
